title: Thai Cod with Algerian Spices
description: A flavorful and spicy cod dish inspired by Algerian cuisine, cooked in a Thai style and finished with roasted vegetables.
instructions: Season the cod fillets with Algerian spice blend and set aside.
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the cod for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until the cod is cooked through.
While the cod is cooking, toss the zucchini and bell peppers with a little olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast the vegetables in the oven for 10-12 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
Remove the skillet from the oven and stir in roasted red pepper flakes and lime juice.
Serve the cod with roasted vegetables and garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
